summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Spare Part Control System completed. 37/37 pytest tests passed (100%). Covered: NIK auth (login/me/change-password), user CRUD with creator-only enforcement, password reset, file upload/download via Emergent Object Storage (header + ?auth= query), spare-parts CRUD, all 5 stage transitions (penawaran/nego/afa/po/datang), status computation precedence (DATANG>PO>AFA>NEGO>PENAWARAN>REQUEST), stamp upload, pagination consistency, filtering (line/month/year/q), validation (422 on missing required), dashboard for all 7 line slugs (pressing/welding/painting/injection/seat/assembling/final-inspection), and monthly reports.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~700 lines — borderline; consider splitting into modules (auth.py, users.py, spare_parts.py, storage.py, models.py) for maintainability if it grows further.
No bcrypt round/cost configured explicitly (uses default 12 — acceptable). Passwords properly hashed with $2b$ format.
Missing brute-force/rate-limit on /api/auth/login — recommended for production (lockout after N failed attempts).
CORS uses '*' from env with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Should use explicit origins when allow_credentials=True.
/api/files/{file_id} accepts JWT via ?auth= query string — convenient for tags but token may end up in server access logs. Consider signed short-lived URLs.
Storage init swallows errors and returns None; subsequent uploads will 500. Acceptable, but consider exposing a /api/health endpoint that reports storage readiness.
list_spare_parts loads up to 10000 docs into memory then paginates in Python — fine at current scale but should move to MongoDB skip/limit + match for status when collection grows.

_update_stage history entry derives date via fields.get(f'{stage.lower()}_date') — works for single-date stages but for /penawaran which can carry both penawaran_date and nego_date, the history entry always logs stage='PENAWARAN' even when only nego_date is supplied. Consider splitting into two endpoints or logging stage='NEGO' when nego_date is the change.
No update endpoint to edit basic fields (nama_barang, qty_order, etc.) once created — by design? Confirm with PRD.
DELETE /api/spare-parts/{id} is creator-only — confirmed and tested. Good.
/api/auth/logout is a no-op (returns ok) — fine for JWT but client must clear local storage; document this.

Storage integration is real (Emergent Object Storage) — uploads/downloads verified byte-equal. Auth uses {nik, password} not email. Status is derived (no stored status field).
